risks: The explicit DAG names Messenger dependencies only; shared CRM schemas, SQL/CAS/outbox, auth capabilities, source-field ACL, revocation, agent/search/activity/memory/attention and Company/mail/task typed relations remain hidden foundation gates. Their actual backend file paths/API signatures were not available in the permitted import graph and must be allocated by the lead rather than guessed.

Name-based suggestContacts and source matching can collapse distinct accounts or attribute another person's same-name history. Keep them only as explicitly standalone/import discovery, not canonical merge/identity/security logic.

Dossier normalization reconstructs known fields, so adding canonical refs only in the UI would silently lose them on persistence. Migration must preserve notes/promises/brief sources and audit aliases without name-only identity.

Rox2 binding Map is not durable CAS and its key excludes workspace; reuse tuple encoding inside a workspace-scoped canonical alias repository, not as an unscoped global contact index. Existing collision quarantine must not be bypassed to support arbitrary merge rebinding.
A person entity kind or an email address is not a Principal. Disabled Write UI and safe-mode prompt wording cannot secure direct login/DM/agent API requests or revoke stale bindings.

Titles, touch counts, search snippets, task notes and retained generated briefs can disclose denied mail context even if the visible private address field is hidden. Policy must apply before aggregation/context construction and to cached projections; disconnected physical erasure cannot be promised.

The current task bridge can await native persistence but has no ContactRef input; switching to createPersonalTaskConfirmed alone would still fail the cross-surface identity DoD and does not prove atomic task+relation persistence.
The specified Dossier route compatibility is intentional; it is not authorization for a duplicate Contacts screen/store. The canonical parser/host is a lead-owned integration seam not inspected here.

Shared ScreenButton defaults to 28px height, smaller than the spec's minimum; contact components need local accepted hitbox sizing. Existing semantic colors/focus styling does not prove actual font, contrast, motion or native layout acceptance.
